subject: Startups
title: Europe's Rising Unicorn Scene
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Europe's Rising Unicorn Scene.

hook.text: Europe produced more unicorns in 2021 alone than in the entire previous decade. The continent finally caught up.

buildup.text: Spotify, Adyen, Klarna, and Revolut proved European startups could build global products from Amsterdam to Stockholm.

discovery.text: Europe's advantage: access to diverse markets from day one.

twist.text: Europe still lacks late-stage funding. Many European unicorns raise their biggest rounds from American VCs.

climax.text: The UK leads with London as Europe's startup capital. But Berlin, Paris, and Stockholm are rising fast.

punchline.text: Europe builds unicorns. America still funds them.

quiz.question: What is a persistent challenge for European unicorns?
options: Too many regulations to start a company
